ValidationRule.description: Validate if at-least one type of valid contact detail is mentioned on the referral record
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Referral', $Profile.Name = 'ANZ CCRM Standard User', NOT($Permission.CCRM_Skip_Validation), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), ISBLANK(MobilePhone), ISBLANK(Home_Phone__c), ISBLANK(Work_Phone__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select the appropriate contact info via the 'Assign Contact' button before proceeding.
